profiles.name: Review Gate — GPT-6 Astra
profiles.notes: High-value GPT review gate for final code/contract review (role=REVIEWER purpose=normal_review). Not for bulk surface/contextual translation review lanes. Prefer a provider different from the candidate author, except GPT-authored candidates may use GPT review to consume Codex subscriptions. A paired cross-reviewer must use a different exact model. Read-only role boundaries and task SPEC remain controlling.

profiles.name: Main Reviewer — GPT-6 Sol
profiles.notes: role=REVIEWER/SENIOR_REVIEWER. Main reviewer for project; default model for surface screening lanes (medium, auto-review). If unavailable, select Grok 4.7, Opus 5.5, or Gemini 3.8 Flash according to the allowed role/purpose, author-provider avoidance, and exact-model diversity requirements.

profiles.name: Review Fallback — Grok 4.7
profiles.notes: Review fallback for role=REVIEWER across contract-allowed purposes and role=SENIOR_REVIEWER purpose=cross_review/scope_audit. Prefer after GPT-6 Sol when its provider is unavailable or provider separation/exact-model diversity requires another model. Do not use grok-4.7-build-fast (2x price). Read-only role boundaries, candidate freeze, review independence, task SPEC, and exact-model diversity remain controlling; never pair reviews using the same exact model.

profiles.name: Review Fallback — Gemini 3.8 Flash
profiles.notes: Fast cross-provider review fallback (Gemini 3.8 Flash via Antigravity subscription) for role=REVIEWER across contract-allowed purposes and role=SENIOR_REVIEWER purpose=cross_review/scope_audit. Prefer after Grok 4.7 when availability, provider separation, or exact-model diversity requires another model. Provider status may show 'Authentication required' while agents still run; verify with an actual dispatch before treating it as unavailable. Read-only role boundaries, candidate freeze, review independence, task SPEC, and exact-model diversity remain controlling; never pair reviews using the same exact model.

profiles.name: Worker Primary — GPT-6 Sol
profiles.notes: Primary role=EXECUTOR worker for standard well-scoped implementation. Existing Paseo role, SPEC, single-writer, and outbound boundaries remain controlling.

profiles.name: Architecture Designer — Fable
profiles.notes: Small-quota architecture challenge and design calibration through role=SENIOR_REVIEWER purpose=scope_audit/cross_review. Read-only: critique and calibrate an existing design or finding set; do not introduce a DESIGNER role, write task files, orchestrate children, or expand beyond SPEC.

profiles.name: Worker — DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
profiles.notes: Low-cost role=EXECUTOR worker using Command Code DeepSeek V4.1 Flash for standard well-scoped implementation. Existing Paseo role, SPEC, single-writer, and outbound boundaries remain controlling.

profiles.name: SCOUT — Gemini 3.8 Flash
profiles.notes: Primary role=SCOUT (read-only source reconnaissance). Best SCOUT overall. Gemini 3.8 Flash via Antigravity subscription.

profiles.name: Contextual Reviewer — Opus 5.5
profiles.notes: role=REVIEWER across contract-allowed purposes and role=SENIOR_REVIEWER purpose=cross_review/scope_audit. Default model for contextual translation review. Distinct exact model from GPT-6 Sol surface lanes.

profiles.name: Reviewer — DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
profiles.notes: role=REVIEWER across contract-allowed purposes and role=SENIOR_REVIEWER purpose=cross_review/scope_audit, low-risk or fallback use only; not a primary contextual reviewer (no measured contextual quality data). Read-only role boundaries, candidate freeze, review independence, task SPEC, and exact-model diversity remain controlling; never pair reviews using the same exact model.
